description: Make an old-west WANTED poster with a sepia photo, name, crime and reward — rendered on aged paper.

faqs.a: Sepia toning, vignette edges, paper grain and the classic type layout recreate the look. The photo is converted to sepia automatically.
faqs.q: How does it get the old-west look?

faqs.a: Yes — for personal, non-commercial fun. Don't use it to impersonate or defame a real person.
faqs.q: Can I put a friend's face on it?

faqs.a: The poster is rendered at 800 × 1100 px PNG, sharp for sharing and small prints.

howto: Choose a photo for the wanted portrait.
Type the outlaw's name, the crime, and the reward amount.
Pick whether they are wanted dead or alive.
Click "Download poster" to save the PNG.
title: Wanted Poster Maker
